scope.claim: Typed registry/cache/route/pricing/result/frame-residue classification; leaf execution and WorldJournal effects remain relations/oracles.
includedSurfaces: standard full-frame and direct STATICCALL route order
precompile gas pricing and result classification
assumptions: native package behavior is an oracle
missing native dependency exits the process

standardBuildSteps: standard source closure excludes zkevm files
inactiveBehavior: inactive address uses ordinary code/delegation lookup
active address resolves provider CodeInfo and no delegation

cache.providerSnapshotOperation: provider map snapshot at construction; array index then dictionary fallback
premises: precompile membership is tested before provider lookup
invalid input is observed only after a cache miss

pricing.localGasRule: full frame uses a local gas copy; direct route debits child gas
pricing.overflowRule: base + data overflow preserves gas and skips Run
pricing.outOfGasRule: ordinary affordability failure clears execution gas and restores state gas through caller
assumptions: leaf computation is not generated or proved

precompileBindings.name: ECRECOVER
inputRules: short input is right padded to 128 bytes
long input is truncated to 128 bytes
outputRules: invalid signature returns successful empty output
failureRules: recover failure is successful empty output

semanticBindings: active precompile -> no delegation and account read/access facts
CALLCODE target -> env.ExecutingAccount and no dead-recipient creation
delegated precompile -> access charged, body suppressed
direct route -> STATICCALL only and RIPEMD excluded
direct pricing failure -> no Run/no snapshot restore; direct leaf failure -> Run/state-gas restore/no snapshot restore
CALLCODE and DELEGATECALL target env.ExecutingAccount; CALL and STATICCALL target codeSource
cancelable dispatch has separate pre-dispatch and boundary cancellation polls; boundary eligibility alone is not cancellation
full-frame pricing hard, returned leaf hard, managed nested soft-revert, and success residues have distinct ordered effects
direct output-copy TrySave bounds failure -> false before UpdateSize/SaveAfterGas and output mutation
WorldJournal callback relation composition gate is explicitly open
